items.title: Buying the dip on tech stocks, Meta moving into enterprise, and the jobs report
items.summary: The Market Hang panel discusses whether it's time to buy the dip in tech stocks, Meta's (META) move into the enterprise space, and what to watch in the upcoming jobs report. Today's Market Hang panel consists of host Turney Duff, Barron's associate editor Al Root, Kelly Intelligence founder Kevin Kelly, Cleo Capital managing director Sarah Kunst, and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian.

items.title: The impact that AI will have on advertising, according to Sir Martin Sorrell
items.summary: Sir Martin Sorrell — the founder and executive chairman of S4Capital — sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss how Meta's (META) new Muse chatbot and other AI products will impact the advertising space.

items.title: The Reason To Buy Autodesk Stock
items.summary: Autodesk (ADSK) stock has fallen 23% since late August. A $10,000 holding bought at the high is now worth about $7,700. A fall that fast pulls you toward buying, but the shares still cost more than the market on earnings. The reason to buy is that past Autodesk drops this deep mostly paid off, and the business is still sound.
